parts:
Buenos dias,

I had the error below while I was trying to compare two models to see if the new model is better that the previous one.


 anova(mod1.fit, mod2.fit)
Error in lavTestLRT(object = new("lavaan", version = "0.6.3", call = lavaan::lavaan(model = mod1,  :
  lavaan ERROR: some models (but not all) have scaled test statistics

lavTestLRT(mod1.fit, mod2.fit)
Error in lavTestLRT(mod1.fit, mod2.fit) :
  lavaan ERROR: some models (but not all) have scaled test statistics


I am not sure what the message "some models (but not all) have scaled test statistics" means. I had the same error using anova or lavTestLRT


Gracias,

Dilys

Dilys

Can you share how you ran the models with cfa or sem? This is saying that the models where analyszed with different estimators, so some have a scaled test statistic (like MLR), and other dont. So, lavaan cant compare them. To compare them the models have to be done with the same estimators
